set.body:
Found in review of the fixture off-screen fix (studio-fixture-offscreen 5f05248). TrialFixation originally carried only WindowSide, losing core MapPlacement distinctions when representing a fixation. Preserve DroppedInitial, OutsideScreen, OutsideWindow(policy), and InMap through the studio trial view; DroppedInitial takes precedence.

Acceptance (corrected with user approval on 2026-09-27): TrialFixation and its view-model carry core MapPlacement end to end through the implemented studio adapter and renderer. The trial view renders and announces the placement states distinctly. Derive test placements from real CoordinateProvenance for both supported core OffWindowPolicy values, Exclude and FailTrial: neither outside-window policy contributes to the map, nor does OutsideScreen or DroppedInitial; InMap does. Core has no Include policy. The future production backend adapter is owned by S3.7; this placement capability must land before S3.7 closes.
